name: collab.submit
title: collab.submit
summary: Submit a replica's optimistic edits: merged field-level onto everything since base; the same field is last-writer-wins and the loser is logged.
html:
Submit a replica's optimistic edits: merged field-level onto everything since base; the same field is last-writer-wins and the loser is logged.

  • Scope: edit:scene
  • Service: collab

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
seqyesThe replica's sequence number (per session, from 1).
baseyesThe revision the replica had applied when it made the change.
editsyesEdits ({op: set|create|delete|move, doc, id, …}), applied as one transaction.
whyWhy, if given.
labelShort label (transform.set).
